title: Term, Notice, Spend Commitment and Entry Requirements of the Corporate Catering Service Agreement
content:
## Part A — term, notice and annual spend

Three figures are printed against each service level of the Corporate Catering Service Agreement: the standard initial term in whole months, the calendar days of notice required to end the agreement, and the annual catering spend the service level is written against.

| Service level | Initial term | Notice to end | Minimum annual spend |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Drop-Off Catering Account | 12 months | 30 days | 4500.00 USD |
| Delivered Buffet Account | 12 months | 30 days | 14000.00 USD |
| Attended Buffet Account | 24 months | 45 days | 42000.00 USD |
| Staffed Full-Service Catering Account | 24 months | 60 days | 110000.00 USD |
| Executive Hospitality Catering Account | 24 months | 60 days | 165000.00 USD |
| Campus Catering Master Account | 36 months | 90 days | 380000.00 USD |

## Part B — entry gate

A service level admits a client on four conditions: the annual spend commitment the client gives, whether a credit check is required, whether a signed master agreement is required before ordering opens, and the largest guest count the level takes on one order.

| Service level | Spend commitment | Credit check | Signed master agreement | Largest guest count per order |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Drop-Off Catering Account | 4500.00 USD | not required | not required | 40 |
| Delivered Buffet Account | 14000.00 USD | required | not required | 120 |
| Attended Buffet Account | 42000.00 USD | required | required | 250 |
| Staffed Full-Service Catering Account | 110000.00 USD | required | required | 450 |
| Executive Hospitality Catering Account | 165000.00 USD | required | required | 60 |
| Campus Catering Master Account | 380000.00 USD | required | required | 900 |

The Drop-Off Catering Account is the only level in the schedule that admits a client without a credit check and without a signed master agreement.
